companyDescription: AI GPU + CPU · MI300X AI accelerators + EPYC server CPUs — the #2 AI chip platform challenging Nvidia in AI training/inference and dominating AMD64 data center server CPU market
priceNote: Down 5.46% today on broad semiconductor sell-off — was $544 yesterday; up 140%+ YTD from $214 at end of 2024
summary: AMD is the clearest AI GPU alternative to Nvidia — data center revenue up 57% YoY, MI300X selling out, and EPYC server CPUs taking share from Intel. Q1 2026 earnings beat drove a 154% YTD run. Today's -5.46% pull-back on sector sell-off is a buying opportunity: Bernstein raised PT to $600 (Outperform), Citi upgraded to Buy with $575 target, BofA reiterates Buy with $560 target. Bull case 2027: AMD's MI350 + MI400 GPU series and $120B TAM server CPU market support $700 by mid-2027.

catalysts.name: MI350 / MI400 GPU Launch — H2 2026
catalysts.description: AMD's next-gen MI350 AI accelerator (CDNA 4) launches H2 2026 targeting inference workloads at hyperscalers. MI400 (CDNA 4 Ultra) follows in 2027. Both target Nvidia H100/H200 displacement in inference — the fastest-growing AI market segment.

catalysts.name: EPYC Genoa/Turin — Server CPU TAM $120B
catalysts.description: AMD EPYC Turin (5th Gen) is taking meaningful share from Intel Xeon in data center CPUs. Bernstein projects AMD's server CPU TAM at $120B as AI compute clusters require high-core-count CPUs alongside GPUs. AMD has 30%+ server CPU market share and growing.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings — AI Accelerating
catalysts.description: Q2 2026 earnings expected late July 2026. Consensus expects continued data center revenue acceleration (+50%+ YoY). AMD 'Advancing AI' event keynote in mid-2026 will preview MI350 roadmap — key catalyst for re-rating.

risks: Nvidia dominance — CUDA ecosystem moat means AMD MI300X wins inference but struggles vs H100/H200 for training; customers prefer Nvidia for new training clusters
Stock already up 140% YTD — much of the AI GPU re-rating may be priced in; incremental upside requires MI350 to meaningfully beat expectations
Intel Arc GPU + Gaudi 3 competition in data center inference — Intel is not giving up market share without a fight
Today's broad semiconductor sell-off (-5.46%) shows macro sensitivity — any AI capex slowdown narrative = pullback

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Rate cuts support high-multiple semiconductor stocks — AMD at ~50x forward P/E benefits from multiple expansion in lower rate environment
macroRisk.inflationNote: HBM memory cost inflation (used in MI300X) is a headwind to GPU gross margins. But AMD passes costs to hyperscalers given strong demand.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Today's broad semiconductor sell-off shows macro risk is real for the sector. AMD specifically benefits from any shift of AI workloads to open-source / CUDA-alternative strategies at hyperscalers.
macroRisk.summary: Fed risk MEDIUM — AMD has run 140%+ YTD and is now sensitive to macro semiconductor risk-off days (today: -5.46%). Rate cuts support multiple. HBM inflation is a margin headwind. Main catalyst is MI350 launch and continued data center revenue acceleration.
